shortDescription: Eight heavy doubles building to triples over 8 sessions with submaximal weights - Doug Hepburn's patient power-pump system for serious strength.
descriptionHtml: Eight heavy doubles building to triples over 8 sessions with submaximal weights - Doug Hepburn's patient power-pump system for serious strength.
author: Doug Hepburn
